items.text: For SNF, Rams WR Puka Nacua and Broncos WR Marvin Mims are both inactive.
items.implication: Zero production; Adams and others primary.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target/route share max; other Rams WRs up.

items.text: Vikings now have ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to an ankle injury.
items.implication: No further stats; Addison and others elevated.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison target share and routes expand significantly.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans is being carted off then ruled out due to a rib injury.
items.why: Carted off mid-game with rib injury; full eval tomorrow.
items.implication: Zero remaining production; monitor for multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Other 49ers WRs/TE Kittle see increased targets/routes.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall has been ruled out with a thigh injury.
items.implication: Remainder of game zero; severity TBD for Week 4+.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane has been ruled out vs. the Chiefs due to a knee injury; coach sounds major concern/not optimistic.
items.why: Knee injury; Hafley 'does not sound very optimistic' on early eval.
items.implication: Significant injury fear; multi-week risk high.
items.opportunity: Backup RBs (Gordon/Wright if available) inherit carries/snaps; pass-game void.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers is active today vs. the Cowboys after pregame workout looking good on hamstring; previously GTD with team not counting on him.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; Schefter confirmed active.
items.implication: Startable but likely limited snaps/usage; late swap risk reduced.
items.opportunity: Limited routes/targets expected; monitor for Bateman/Andrews boost if restricted.

items.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb, per coach Todd Bowles. MRI tomorrow. But likely to miss time.
items.why: Dislocated thumb on INT; MRI upcoming, miss time expected.
items.implication: Backup QB for rest of game/Week 4+; Bucs pass game downgrade.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; WRs like Egbuka/Godwin may see altered usage.

items.text: TE Brock Bowers is active and will make his 2026 season debut today.
items.why: Cleared for debut after prior absence.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside in Raiders offense.
items.opportunity: High route/target share expected as featured TE.

items.text: Risky for sure but if Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me. I would start him over Bateman.
items.why: Active confirmation; prefers over Bateman despite risk.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy lineups if rostered.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if full; otherwise shared.
items.conflict: ETR initially projected OUT with limited upside if active.

items.text: Actives today include Steelers RB Jaylen Warren and (via prior) Michael Pittman expected/active; DJ Moore and Keon Coleman active for Bills.
items.why: Confirmed in actives list; Pittman expected earlier.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles; Warren volume bump possible without Dowdle.
items.opportunity: Warren carries/routes; Pittman targets; Moore limited possible.

items.text: Jets WR AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WRs today: 1. Garrett Wilson 2. Isaiah Williams 3. Jamaal Pritchett 4. Sterling Shepard 5. Malik McLain. Also expecting TE Kenyon Sadiq to line up slot/wide a decent amount.
items.why: Fowler source; Levitan depth chart update.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1; secondary WRs and Sadiq elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Wilson target monopoly; Sadiq slot/wide snaps/routes increase.

items.text: We have Zay Flowers (hamstring) out in projections right now. Still possible he plays, will keep late swap in mind for Bateman/Andrews DFS situations.
items.why: Team not counting on him; no confirmation yet at AM window.
items.implication: Fade in early projections; pivot to Bateman/Andrews.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Bateman/Andrews target/route share spikes.
items.conflict: Later confirmed ACTIVE by Schefter/Rapoport; Berry starts him.

items.text: Summary of weekend FantasyFootball reports: GTD Zay Flowers (not counting on him), Tyjae Spears (hopeful); EXPECTED Jaylen Warren, Michael Pittman, Saquon Barkley, Devonta Smith, Brock Bowers, Mike Evans, Jalen Coker, Keon Coleman; Q Colby Parkinson, Tyson Bagent.
items.why: Comprehensive AM status parse from reports.
items.implication: Most key players lean in; Flowers high risk OUT.
items.opportunity: Full roles for expected; monitor Flowers for reverse beneficiaries.
items.conflict: Flowers later ACTIVE; Evans later OUT mid-game.

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup and prop line support volume/TD upside.
items.opportunity: High carry share, goal-line work vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games, RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.
items.opportunity: High target share and aDOT maintained.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snap rate and just five touches post-fumble; JAX allows only 55 rush yds/game to RBs, 3.2 YPC.
items.why: Diminished role + tough run D matchup.
items.opportunity: Reduced snaps/carries post-fumble; Henderson or others may benefit.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV: only 49% RB touches, 38% third-down snaps even with Kamara active; role not there (RB37 utilization).
